hypothesis_primary: An error-risk ranker using frozen-reference confidence plus independent-retraining disagreement and probability dispersion reduces realized streaming review-cost compared with a separately supervised confidence-only error-risk ranker on the final held-out CO2 time block.
hypothesis_mechanism: Disagreement contributes only when the conditional error risk given confidence and reference class crosses the review cost boundary; mere conditional dependence is insufficient for benefit at that cost.
theory: r0=P(error|confidence,reference_class); r1=P(error|confidence,reference_class,disagreement); V_lambda=E[(r1-lambda)_+]-E[(r0-lambda)_+] >= 0 for ideal true risks, no guarantee for estimated risks
new_data: statsmodels.datasets.co2.load_pandas, original weekly 1958-2001 observed co2 values
data_task: binary label 1 if next observed weekly CO2 concentration is strictly higher than current observed weekly value; exclude pairs with raw current or next week missing; features are current/past information only
missing_handling: forward-fill historical CO2 levels only for feature lags, never interpolate targets with future values
gap: at least 8 weeks between adjacent train/validation/test label windows; dates in gap excluded
reference_selection: fixed, never selected using validation/test labels

candidate_risk_rankers.calibrated_confidence: L2 logistic regression fitted using validation error labels on [1-confidence, reference_class]
candidate_risk_rankers.calibrated_conditional: L2 logistic regression fitted using validation error labels on [1-confidence, reference_class, disagreement, probability_std, (1-confidence)*disagreement]

primary_endpoint: holdout mean [incorrect AND accepted + lambda * reviewed] per case for streaming validation-frozen thresholds; comparator is supervised calibrated_confidence
secondary_endpoints: batch-exact review count risk contrast at review fraction .20
heldout Brier score for error risk
mean bootstrap cost contrast by moving blocks
tie_handling: validation boundary tie probability frozen; test ties randomized by fixed SHA256 hash of temporal case identity and seed 55043

bootstrap.type: moving blocks on temporal case order
bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive; does not prove time-series generalization

historical_A06: previously inspected R4 outputs; reanalysis only, no p-value or new confirmation
stop_rules: report all four families both folds including ties, adverse effects, and out-of-range review rates; no post-test hyperparameter changes
forbidden: relabelling historical R4 as independent confirmation
using heldout labels to tune policies
calling known value of information equation novel
claiming model reproducibility implies prediction correctness
claiming PRNG seeds prove IID retraining
claiming a temporal series is multiple independent datasets
